questions.question: What is the past tense of "walk"?
questions.explanation: For regular verbs, we add -ed to make the past tense. Walk becomes walked.

questions.question: What is the past tense of "go"?
questions.explanation: "Go" is an irregular verb. The past tense is "went".

questions.question: Which word often goes with past tense?
questions.explanation: "Yesterday" tells us something happened in the past, so we use past tense.

questions.question: Kva er fortid av "see"?
questions.explanation: "See" is an irregular verb. The past tense is "saw".

questions.question: Which sentence is in the past tense?
questions.explanation: "I played" uses the past tense -ed ending and "yesterday" confirms its the past.
